journey.name: Wear - Feed Browse
journey.description:
Verifies that the feed can be read from top to bottom with the rotary crown, that every kind of card (text, image, video, repost, long name) is fully readable inside the round screen, and that switching to another feed and back keeps the choice.
Run on a round Wear OS emulator with the bench build. Start with the app stopped. Scroll with the rotary crown one notch at a time; commands are in docs/wear-testing.md.

actions.action: Launch Nubecita on the watch with the bench scenario "default"
Tap Home
Verify that the feed header reads "Following" and the first card shows Ana Ruiz, a relative time, the start of the text "Golden hour from the pier tonight" and an image
Verify that the clock at the top of the screen does not overlap the feed header
Scroll down one notch at a time with the rotary crown until the post by Cleo Marsh that begins "The lake was perfectly still" is in the middle of the screen
Verify that the card in the middle of the screen shows its author, its time and its text without being cut by the edge of the round screen
Scroll down one notch at a time until the post that begins "Anyone else read on their watch now?" is in the middle of the screen
Verify that the card shows a line that begins "Reposted by @ben" above the author Ana Ruiz
Scroll down one notch at a time until the post that begins "City lights from the train home" is in the middle of the screen
Verify that the card shows a visible mark that its media is a video, not only an image
Scroll down until the feed does not move any further
Verify that the last card, by "depths of wikipedia with a long display name", is fully inside the screen with its text and image readable and nothing cut by the bottom edge
Scroll up until the feed does not move any further
Verify that the feed header "Following" is visible again
Tap the feed header
Verify that a list titled "Feeds" shows Following and Morning Photos, with Following marked as the current feed
Tap Morning Photos
Verify that the feed header reads "Morning Photos" and the first card is by Cleo Marsh with the text "First light over the hills."
Tap the first card
Verify that the post by Cleo Marsh is shown on its own screen
Swipe right from the left edge of the screen to go back
Verify that the feed header still reads "Morning Photos"
Swipe right from the left edge of the screen to go back
Verify that the landing screen is shown
Tap Home
Verify that the feed header still reads "Morning Photos"
Tap the feed header and then tap Following
Verify that the feed header reads "Following" and the first card is by Ana Ruiz
